note: Adapted from the species description of Speculitermes dharwarensis in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; no soldier is recorded, only the alate and the worker; synonymy citations, figure references and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule brown; mid-dorsal spot pale yellow; tergites pale brown and translucent, sternites translucent; abdomen dark grey owing to gut contents. Head and thorax moderately pilose, abdomen more densely pilose. Total body length about 3.7-5.5 mm. Head subcircular, wider than long (length to mandible base 0.87-1.0, maximum width 1.03-1.23 mm); Y-shaped suture faint; mid-dorsal spot circular (diameter 0.11-0.13 mm), not raised. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 equal to or slightly longer than segment 2, faintly subdivided. Postclypeus brown, raised, half as long as wide or slightly more than half (length 0.25-0.27, width 0.43-0.53 mm). Labrum hemispherical, length 0.30-0.40, width 0.45-0.57 mm. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.30-0.37, width 0.57-0.73 mm), anterior and posterior margins without notches.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown; postclypeus, mid-dorsal spot and thoracic and abdominal tergites slightly paler; labrum and antennae pale brown; legs brown; sternites dark brown, paler medially. Head and body surface covered with a thick layer of short, fine hairs, plus several long setae. Total body length about 7.3 mm. Head subcircular (length to mandible base 1.17, width including compound eyes 1.50 mm), dorsally slightly depressed around the fontanelle plate (mid-dorsal spot). Mid-dorsal spot circular and raised, diameter 0.17 mm. Compound eyes subcircular, slightly narrowed toward the lateral margins, maximum diameter 0.39 mm. Ocelli broadly oval to subcircular, maximum diameter 0.17 mm, separated from the compound eye by less than half their long diameter (0.07 mm). Antennae with more than 14 segments, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus strongly raised, slightly longer than half its width (length 0.37, width 0.66 mm), anterior margin straight, posterior margin rounded. Anteclypeus transparent, trapezoidal, anterior margin produced medially. Labrum hemispherical, wider than long (length 0.43, width 0.57 mm). Pronotum narrower than head including eyes (length 0.83, width 1.40 mm); anterior margin slightly emarginate with a median notch, posterior margin nearly straight and weakly emarginate medially, sides strongly narrowed posteriorly. Posterior margins of meso- and metanotum deeply concave.
